title: The Intersection of Health Sciences and Geography

sentences.en: A. While many diseases that affect humans have been eradicated due to improvements in vaccinations and the availability of healthcare, there are still areas around the world where certain health issues are more prevalent.
sentences.zh: 答：虽然由于疫苗接种的改进和医疗保健的可用性,许多影响人类的疾病已经被根除,但世界上的某些地区仍然存在某些健康问题更为普遍。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: In a world that is far more globalised than ever before, people come into contact with one another through travel and living closer and closer to each other.
sentences.zh: 在一个比以往任何时候都更加全球化的世界中,人们通过旅行和生活彼此越来越接近地相互接触。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: As a result, super-viruses and other infections resistant to antibiotics are becoming more and more common.
sentences.zh: 因此,超级病毒和其他对抗生素耐药的感染变得越来越普遍。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: B. Geography can often play a very large role in the health concerns of certain populations.
sentences.zh: B. 地理因素通常在某些人群的健康问题中发挥着非常大的作用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For instance, depending on where you live, you will not have the same health concerns as someone who lives in a different geographical region.
sentences.zh: 例如,根据您居住的地方,您不会与居住在不同地理区域的人有相同的健康问题。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Perhaps one of the most obvious examples of this idea is malaria-prone areas, which are usually tropical regions that foster a warm and damp environment in which the mosquitos that can give people this disease can grow.
sentences.zh: 也许这一想法最明显的例子之一是疟疾高发地区,这些地区通常是热带地区,这些地区营造出温暖潮湿的环境,可以让传播这种疾病的蚊子生长。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Malaria is much less of a problem in high-altitude deserts, for instance.
sentences.zh: 例如,疟疾在高海拔沙漠中就不是什么问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: C. In some countries, geographical factors influence the health and well-being of the population in very obvious ways.
sentences.zh: C. 在一些国家,地理因素以非常明显的方式影响人口的健康和福祉。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In many large cities, the wind is not strong enough to clear the air of the massive amounts of smog and pollution that cause asthma, lung problems, eyesight issues and more in the people who live there.
sentences.zh: 在许多大城市,风力不足以清除空气中的大量烟雾和污染,这些烟雾和污染会导致居住在那里的人们出现哮喘、肺部问题、视力问题等。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Part of the problem is, of course, the massive number of cars being driven, in addition to factories that run on coal power.
sentences.zh: 当然,问题的一部分在于,除了依靠煤电运行的工厂之外,还有大量的汽车在行驶。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The rapid industrialisation of some countries in recent years has also led to the cutting down of forests to allow for the expansion of big cities, which makes it even harder to fight the pollution with the fresh air that is produced by plants.
sentences.zh: 一些国家近年来的快速工业化也导致了为了大城市的扩张而砍伐森林,这使得利用植物产生的新鲜空气来对抗污染变得更加困难。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: D. It is in situations like these that the field of health geography comes into its own.
sentences.zh: D. 正是在这样的情况下,健康地理学领域发挥了自己的作用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It is an increasingly important area of study in a world where diseases like polio are re-emerging, respiratory diseases continue to spread, and malaria-prone areas are still fighting to find a better cure.
sentences.zh: 在当今世界,脊髓灰质炎等疾病重新出现,呼吸道疾病继续蔓延,疟疾高发地区仍在努力寻找更好的治疗方法,这是一个日益重要的研究领域。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Health geography is the combination of, on the one hand, knowledge regarding geography and methods used to analyse and interpret geographical information, and on the other, the study of health, diseases and healthcare practices around the world.
sentences.zh: 健康地理学一方面是地理知识和用于分析和解释地理信息的方法的结合,另一方面是对世界各地健康、疾病和医疗保健实践的研究。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The aim of this hybrid science is to create solutions for common geography-based health problems.
sentences.zh: 这种混合科学的目的是为常见的基于地理的健康问题创建解决方案。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: While people will always be prone to illness, the study of how geography affects our health could lead to the eradication of certain illnesses, and the prevention of others in the future.
sentences.zh: 虽然人们总是容易生病,但对地理如何影响我们健康的研究可能会消除某些疾病,并在未来预防其他疾病。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: By understanding why and how we get sick, we can change the way we treat illness and disease specific to certain geographical locations.
sentences.zh: 通过了解我们生病的原因和方式,我们可以改变治疗特定地理位置疾病的方式。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: E. The geography of disease and ill health analyses the frequency with which certain diseases appear in different parts of the world, and overlays the data with the geography of the region, to see if there could be a correlation between the two.
sentences.zh: E. 疾病和健康不良地理学分析了某些疾病在世界不同地区出现的频率,并将数据与该地区的地理重叠,看看两者之间是否存在相关性。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Health geographers also study factors that could make certain individuals or a population more likely to be taken ill with a specific health concern or disease, as compared with the population of another area.
sentences.zh: 健康地理学家还研究与其他地区的人口相比,可能使某些个人或群体更容易患某种特定健康问题或疾病的因素。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Health geographers in this field are usually trained as healthcare workers, and have an understanding of basic epidemiology as it relates to the spread of diseases among the population.
sentences.zh: 该领域的健康地理学家通常接受过医疗保健工作者的培训,并且了解基本的流行病学,因为它与疾病在人群中的传播有关。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: F. Researchers study the interactions between humans and their environment that could lead to illness (such as asthma in places with high levels of pollution) and work to create a clear way of categorising illnesses, diseases and epidemics into local and global scales.
sentences.zh: F. 研究人员研究人类与环境之间可能导致疾病的相互作用（例如污染严重的地方的哮喘）,并努力创建一种明确的方法,将疾病和流行病分类为本地和全球范围。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Health geographers can map the spread of illnesses and attempt to identify the reasons behind an increase or decrease in illnesses, as they work to find a way to halt the further spread or re-emergence of diseases in vulnerable populations.
sentences.zh: 健康地理学家可以绘制疾病的传播地图,并尝试找出疾病增加或减少背后的原因,同时他们努力寻找一种方法来阻止疾病在弱势群体中进一步传播或重新出现。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: G. The second subcategory of health geography is the geography of healthcare provision.
sentences.zh: G. 健康地理学的第二个子类别是医疗保健提供地理学。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This group studies the availability (or lack thereof) of healthcare resources to individuals and populations around the world.
sentences.zh: 该小组研究世界各地个人和人群的医疗保健资源的可用性（或缺乏）。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In both developed and developing nations there is often a very large discrepancy between the options available to people in different social classes, income brackets, and levels of education.
sentences.zh: 在发达国家和发展中国家,不同社会阶层、收入阶层和教育水平的人们的选择往往存在很大差异。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Individuals working in the area of the geography of healthcare provision attempt to assess the levels of healthcare in the area (for instance, it may be very difficult for people to get medical attention because there is a mountain between their village and the nearest hospital).
sentences.zh: 在医疗保健提供地理领域工作的个人试图评估该地区的医疗保健水平（例如,人们可能很难获得医疗护理,因为他们的村庄和最近的医院之间有一座山）。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: These researchers are on the frontline of making recommendations regarding policy to international organisations, local government bodies and others.
sentences.zh: 这些研究人员处于向国际组织、地方政府机构和其他机构提出政策建议的第一线。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: H. The field of health geography is often overlooked, but it constitutes a huge area of need in the fields of geography and healthcare.
sentences.zh: H. 健康地理学领域经常被忽视,但它构成了地理学和医疗保健领域的巨大需求领域。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: If we can understand how geography affects our health no matter where in the world we are located, we can better treat disease, prevent illness, and keep people safe and well.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能够了解地理如何影响我们的健康,无论我们身在世界何处,我们就可以更好地治疗疾病、预防疾病并保证人们的安全和健康。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。
